reading: SpaceX has recovered the upper section of its Starship rocket for the first time after a journey lasting twenty-two and a half hours.
Near the launch tower, it was secured by mechanical arms nicknamed chopsticks.
The company also planned to catch the lower section, but cancelled this attempt a few minutes after launch.
The lower section, called the Super Heavy booster, was due to return six and a half minutes after launch.
However, the booster automatically changed direction towards the ocean, hovered above the water and then exploded.
The upper section deployed 26 satellites that are part of Starlink, a system providing high-speed internet.
It completed 14 orbits, or full journeys around Earth, before returning to the launch tower.
SpaceX wants both sections to be reusable, meaning they can be used for future flights.
Recovering both sections reliably would allow SpaceX to launch Starship repeatedly and greatly reduce costs.
The company had already caught the booster on three earlier test flights.
Before the flight, SpaceX said it would try to catch the upper section only after carefully assessing its condition in space.

vocabulary.definition: An act of trying to do something, especially something difficult.
Released equipment into the place where it would be used.
Complete journeys around a planet or another object in space.
Able to be used more than once.
In a way that can be trusted to work successfully each time.
Make the amount of money needed for something smaller.
Carefully checking something to make a judgment about it.
